name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 12, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Excellence in Environmental Stewardship Non-Profit Organization Award category to the Encinitas Ranch Community Association. Accepting the award is Richard P. Stern, President, Encinitas Ranch Community Association.
4B.
Presentation of Excellence in Environmental Stewardship For-Profit Business Award category to the Inn at Moonlight Beach. Accepting the award is Shangwen Kennedy, the owner of The Inn at Moonlight Beach.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 17, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, June 17, 2020 Regular Meeting, June 24, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, June 24, 2020 Regular Meeting, June 29, 2020 Special Meeting, and July 29, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-08-12 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Introduction of Ordinance 2020-12 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 Conflict of Interest Code. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance 2020-12 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 regarding Conflict of Interest filers.”
2020-08-12 Item 08B City Conflict of Interest Code Amendments
8C.
Approval of plans and specifications, and authorization to advertise the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project Phase 1 (CC04J). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Approve the plans, specifications, and authorize the advertisement of the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project Phase 1 (CC04J).
2020-08-12 Item 08C Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project Phase 1 CC04J
8D.
Design Agreement to support the Pre-construction, Engineering and Design (PED) Phase for the Encinitas – Solana Beach Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project (now referred to as the San Diego County Storm Damage Reduction Project). Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Design Agreement with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Department of the Army) for the Encinitas-Solana Beach Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project (now referred to as the San Diego County Storm Damage Reduction Project); and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign and execute related documents, such as the Project Management Plan, and certifications as may be needed during the pre-construction, engineering and design (PED) phase, provided those do not involve increases to the approved Design Agreement (DA) budget.
2020-08-12 Item 08D San Diego County Storm Damage Reduction Project
8E.
Legislative position letter in support to AB 3153 (McGuire). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Ratify the position letter in support of AB 3153 (McGuire) signed by the Mayor on July 2, 2020.
2020-08-12 Item 08E Legislative Letter in Support to AB 3153
8F.
Appointments to the Youth Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with the approval of City Council, appoint nine (9) applicants to the Youth Commission with terms ending June 2021.
2020-08-12 Item 08F Youth Commission Appointments - Redacted
8G.
Lease/purchase financing for the City’s purchase of a Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper Fire Engine in the amount of $737,623, as a reimbursement to the City’s General Fund. Contact Person: Finance Manager Huang
“A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Authorizing Entering into a New Lease Under a Master Equipment Lease Purchase Agreement and the Execution and Delivery of Related Instruments, and Determining Other Matters in Connection Therewith;” and 2) Authorize the City Treasurer and City Manager to take any and all necessary steps to complete the financing of the Pierce Arrow Triple Combination Pumper Fire Engine, including the execution of a contract and financing arrangements, with the Pinnacle Public Finance, Inc.
2020-08-12 Item 08G Fire Truck Lease Financing
8H.
Construction Contract award for the Fiscal Year (FY) 2019/20 Citywide Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CC04E and CE04H). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
$131,308 for CC04E and $131,308 for CE04H.
2020-08-12 Item 08H Citywide Sewer Rehab Project FY 2019-20
8I.
Ratification of Fee Waivers for Street and Sidewalk Encroachments and Park Commercial Use. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Ratify fee waivers due to the COVID-19 Emergency Declaration.
2020-08-12 Item 08I Ratification of Fee Waivers
8J.
Adopt Budget Resolution 2020-70 for Receipt of an Allocation of Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act Funds from the State of California. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Adopt Budget Resolution authorizing receipt of CARES Funds provided by the State of California.
2020-08-12 Item 08J CARES Act Allocation
2020-08-12 Item 08J CARES Act Allocation - Amended Resolution (Posted 8-11-2020)
8K.
Consideration of the Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant to develop the Modal Alternatives Project Implementation Plan (MAP Encinitas) including an off-cycle budget amendment of $250,000 to appropriate the CIP project. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
1) Accept the Caltrans Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant in order to develop the Modal Alternatives Project Implementation Plan (MAP Encinitas); 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-63 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Appointment of the City Manager as an Authorized Representative to Enter into Contracts with the State of California for a Sustainable Transportation Planning Grant for MAP Encinitas Funding;” and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-64 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget,” which authorizes appropriation of grant funding in the amount of $200,000 to the Modal Alternatives Project “MAP Encinitas” Implementation Plan project, Project No. WC21A and approves a budget transfer to said project from Consolidated Plan (CDGB Program) (WC19C) in the amount of $20,000 for public noticing and printing and from Rail Corridor Cross Connect Grant (WC19D) in the amount of $30,000 for the local match.
2020-08-12 Item 08K CalTrans MAP Grant Acceptance
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Approve Project Management Plan Amendment and Funding for the El Portal Bike and Pedestrian Undercrossing (CS16F). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the amended Project Management Plan (PMP) with San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) and North County Transit District (NCTD), in substantial form as provided and any necessary amendments and time extensions for construction of the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project; 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-61, entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget" to allocate $1,450,000 to the El Portal Pedestrian Undercrossing (CS16F); 3) Direct staff to pay $2,200,000 to SANDAG in August 2020 to fund the construction contract and initial costs for the El Portal Pedestrian Undercrossing project; and 4) As construction circumstances necessitate, direct staff to pay SANDAG the balance of their construction support costs, up to the current estimate of $963,000, in July 2021 to fully fund the construction phase of the El Portal Pedestrian Undercrossing project.
2020-08-12 Item 10A Approval of PMP Amendment El Portal Bike & Pedestrian Undercrossing
2020-08-12 Item 10A Approval of PMP Amendment El Portal Bike & Pedestrian Undercrossing - Amended Page 2 (Posted 8-12-2020 10:10 a.m.)
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING IS SCHEDULED FOR AUGUST 19, 2020.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
